name: earthly-maps
description: Preview geographic data, publish public Nostr maps, and generate configured website iframes.

interface.longDescription: Create interactive maps from supplied or conversation-generated GeoJSON. Find location candidates, preview maps in chat, publish publicly to Nostr, and generate configured iframes. Public pilot with temporary guest editing sessions and bounded inline datasets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Map the places we discussed, then help me share and embed the map.
